item.title: Didgeridoo 1.0.0
item.description:
• The instrument can now behave like the real ones measured in acoustics research. Seven new knobs, all at 0 until you turn them:
    • Tongue (Mouth): a raised tongue takes sound away at three resonances of the mouth; the band left between them is the moving overtone. It follows Vowel and lifts the drone by up to a third of a semitone.
    • Tube (new panel Tube): the tube's own resonances make the fundamental stand out above its harmonics. Toot Pitch says what tube it is: 19 st a plain pipe with strong odd harmonics, around 16 st a flared instrument.
    • Toot Len (Tube): an overblown note can be a short stab after which the drone comes back, instead of lasting as long as the key.
    • Voice (Lips): a sung voice locked in tune with the drone at the interval of Growl Pitch; a fifth or a tenth adds a tone an octave below.
    • Pattern, Accent, Breath In (Rhythm): accented and soft steps, and a quick in-breath on the soft ones as in circular breathing.
  • Four new programs use them: Eucalyptus, Hard Tongue, Pipe and Singer.
  • The window has a fourth panel, Tube, which also holds Toot Vel, Toot Pitch, Glide, Bend Range and Octave. The window is a little taller.
  • The six earlier programs and saved sounds are unchanged, sample for sample. The new knobs and programs are a deliberate difference from the MPC plugin "Didgeridoo".
